title: Concept: Possible an SSH key passphrase passed with --ssh-passphrase in source
description: an SSH key passphrase passed with --ssh-passphrase written into a script ships with the repository and with every build log that echoes the command. Rotation plus removing the literal argument is the durable fix.
applicability: Shell scripts, CI job definitions, Dockerfiles, Makefiles and runbooks that may contain an SSH key passphrase passed with --ssh-passphrase.
risk: Use of the credential by anyone who can read the script, the image or the CI log; HIGH severity.
